tbesh_subentries.definition_html: to gather, collect, gather stubble or sticks

1) to gather, assemble
1a) (Qal) to gather together
1b) (Hithpoel) to gather oneself together

tbesh_html: to gather, collect, gather stubble or sticks

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to forage for straw, stubble or wood; figuratively, to assemble
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; to become sapless through drought; used only as denominative from H7179 (קַשׁ);
